subject: [hw] DEC04 -> V40: patches ready (dec04.patch + test adaptation), 1872/1872 incl. your 1440/1440
body:
Diff is ready. Base: n2vcu.c sha256 4d2d2eb4cbb3ff4ad049fec9bfef92d14f81927adafd064a88b5bb59c7622b02, n2vcu.h 32cfaf8f800d274633f4d270ba5c2aef611c9f127864eb2fac148d43aba6960f, t_v40.c 709867b375e92012520eb8165ece8d00d3ab5cc631dddeea1fefd726a77478f5 (rev 5, before your opus-lead rev 6; these hunks are in other regions, but say the word and I rebase on rev 6).

  gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/dec04.patch              sha256 a00cab9e...f8e  (production: n2vcu.c, n2vcu.h)
  gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/dec04-v40-adapt.patch    sha256 8580d5f7...679  (your t_v40.c only)
  apply: patch -p1 -d <tree> < dec04.patch && patch -p1 -d <tree> < dec04-v40-adapt.patch

Production patch, exactly as agreed: (1) vcu_windows[] appends {0x16000000,0x30000,RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL} after the ten VDEC entries and before the two VENC ones; first match wins, so all old indices and K02 sequences are unchanged, and only 0x1000/0x2000/0x3800, larb5 0xd000, 0xe000, 0x11800, LAT 0x12000-0x18800, AVC_VLD 0x22000, PP 0x24000, 0x29000, larb4 0x2e000 and the 0x11400-0x11fff tail reach it. Same table serves guest MMIO and GCE commands (DEC02 may show GCE writes in the gaps; dropping them would hide a real access). (2) write-combining default OFF, n2vcu_set_write_combining(v,on); aligned 32-bit stores queue and leave as one batch, flushed before guest read, sub-word/unaligned store, GCE entry, wait_irq/poll, power change, any ioctl entry, close, destroy, and at 256 ops; a full-word store now skips the pointless RMW read entirely. (3) stats appended: hw_regs_calls (every hw->regs call = one RWVC_REGS ioctl on the phone) + wc_writes/wc_flushes/wc_batch_ops/wc_max_batch/wc_forced/wc_errors. No other behaviour change with wc off except the RMW read is still there, so your t_mmap_regs sees the same array.

Test adaptation patch (your file): FHW_WIN_WORDS 0x1000 -> 0xc000 and fhw_win[] gains {0x30000}; the 0x16001000 case now expects one op in RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL and gce_skipped +2 instead of +3. Without it your suite fails exactly two checks ("bad addresses skipped" -EINVAL from the 16 KiB fake window, "three commands skipped"), which is the by-design consequence of rev 3, not a model bug; I verified that run too.

Results on a /tmp mirror from the current tree:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vcu/test_dec04/run_tests.sh
    DEC04 t_dec04 asan SUMMARY 144 144
    DEC04 t_dec04 o2   SUMMARY 144 144
    DEC04 t_dec04 tsan SUMMARY 144 144
    DEC04 IOCTLS off=369 on=124 guest_stores=145 batches=45 max_batch=8
    N2TEST V40 PASS 1440/1440
    N2TEST DEC04 PASS 1872/1872
  N2TEST V40-IOS PASS 1/1 (patched n2vcu.c, arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only; manual run, the SDK path is not in the mirror)

Header rev 3 is still not in the tree, so both the runner and my suite stage the proposed enum line in /tmp only (tree header untouched); the patch spells RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL, never 12. If hw-lead changes the text, only the staging line changes. The oracle replay, not just counts: same ordered write record (window/offset/value/mask), same final image of every window, same guest read values, mmio_bad 0 and gce_skipped 0 with and without combining.
